tool.description: If you are like many computer users, you would frequently like to make changes in various text files wherever certain patterns appear, or extract data from parts of certain lines while discarding the rest. The job is easy with awk, especially the GNU implementation gawk.
tool.command:
<![CDATA[
${unzip}

    awk \\
        ${args} \\

]]>
